record_scope_reconstruction: Togolese election land-border policy, but this operational phase is restricted to the two road crossings with reported April 30 traffic: Aflao on Ghana frontier and Hilacondji/Sanveecondji on Benin frontier.

source_checks.finding: Full relevant report inspected: national April 29 polling order, followed by early April 30 observed traffic at Aflao and same finding at Hilacondji. Does not prove every Togolese post reopened.
Named Ghana Immigration Service–Aflao Border Post, OSM node 14140322711; used as paired road crossing reference, not attribution of the Togolese closure to Ghana.
